call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Handset Revenue Slump (-26% YoY) & Premium ASP Offsets
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Can you unpack the 26% year-over-year decline in QCT Handset revenues to $5.14B, and how much traction the new Snapdragon 8 Elite is seeing in offsetting mature smartphone volume drag?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.management_answer: Cristiano Amon explained that the prior year comparison included anomalous channel replenishment. In Q4, premium and high-tier content expanded significantly with Chinese OEMs adopting the Snapdragon 8 Elite, which commands substantially higher ASPs. Smartphone volume may be mature, but silicon dollar content per device is rising 15-20%.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Wafer Input Cost Inflation & Gross Margin Inflection Timeline
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Management explicitly cited broad-based semiconductor input cost increases across wafers, packaging, and materials. When will pricing adjustments fully offset these cost pressures in gross margins?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.management_answer: CFO Akash Palkhiwala stated that cost inflation at leading-edge foundry nodes is being actively addressed via renegotiated contract pricing with OEM partners. However, because product shipments lag price adjustments, the full benefit to QCT gross margins will materialize in the second half of fiscal 2027.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Automotive $2B Milestone & Amazon AI Data Center Architecture
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Automotive reached a historic $1.99B run-rate growing 89% YoY. Concurrently, you announced an Amazon data center collaboration. How should investors model the FY27 $5B data center ramp vs automotive?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.management_answer: Cristiano Amon highlighted that the automotive design win backlog now exceeds $45B, with ADAS and digital cockpit deployments scaling globally. The Amazon partnership represents a multi-generational inference architecture that will ramp in late FY27, underpinning the reiterated $5B data center revenue target.
